figurative_meaning_en: Fourteen generations of descendants in the line of sons and grandsons
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জমিটা চোদ্দপুরুষ ধরে আমার পরিবারের হাতে আছে।
তার পাপের প্রতিফল চোদ্দপুরুষ ভোগ করবে।
example_sentences_in_english: This land has been in my family for fourteen generations.
He will pay for his sins for fourteen generations.
history: Refers to the traditional Bengali emphasis on multi-generational family lineages and inheritance practices.
note: The number 'fourteen' is hyperbolic, implying an indefinitely long period.
